description: Project-wide instructions for language and communication rules, including English for documentation and Portuguese for chat interactions.
applyTo: '**/*'

# Project language instructions

## Documentation language

- All project documentation must be written in English.
- This includes README files, Markdown documentation, inline comments, examples, and any other repository-facing written content.
- Prefer clear, natural English and keep terminology consistent with the project domain.

## Chat and Copilot interaction language

- All responses and interactions with the user in chat or Copilot must be written in Portuguese.
- Technical explanations, code suggestions, and review comments should still be delivered in Portuguese even when referencing English technical terms.

## Intent

These rules ensure that repository documentation stays consistent and professional in English while user-facing conversations remain natural and clear in Portuguese.
